in_marathi.name: Garg
in_marathi.long_meaning: Garg हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, the name Garg means 'cowherd' or 'protector'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'gargha', meaning 'cow'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as a cowherd, and the name Garg is associated with this divine figure.
